header: Four-robot convoy counterflow scene, rerun  ·  demonstration take 1 of 1  ·  VLM: Gemini Robotics-ER 2
camera_label: Left: real overhead camera of the simulation (topic /perception/annotated_frame). The red boxes and robot ids were drawn on it by the perception module (M1) during the run.
intro_lines: robot_1 drives east into a narrow gate between two barriers and meets robot_2 nose to nose; robot_3 and robot_4 queue behind robot_1 at the west end, with goals east of the gate. When a robot has been stuck for 12 s, the coordination layer asks a vision-language model (VLM) what to do: it sends a text prompt and the current camera image, the grounder (M3) checks the answer, and the system executes it.

The five earlier convoy takes did not resolve: in takes 1-3 the two queued robots were released without a command; in takes 4-5 the model chose robot_1, which had robots queued behind it, as the yielder. This rerun has the grounder's queued-robot hold switched on.
Robots: 4  ·  Model: Gemini Robotics-ER 2 (gemini-robotics-er-2-preview)  ·  Rerun, demonstration take 1 of 1, recorded 2026-11-15.
Left: real overhead camera of the simulation. Right: the run's own logs, replayed in sync with simulation time.
watch_for: The model's answer involves only two robots, robot_1 and robot_2; the queued robots are left on 'continue' (yellow lines on the right).
The 'Check' stage shows the grounder adding the two queued robots, robot_3 and robot_4 (orange lines).
The robots pass the gate one at a time.

captions.text: robot_1 drives east into the gate and meets robot_2 coming the other way; robot_3 and robot_4 queue at the west end.
Trigger: robot_2 has been stuck for 12 s. The coordination layer sends the model a text prompt and the current camera image; the wait for its answer plays in real time.
Model's plan: robot_2 yields (backs out and pulls aside), robot_1 crosses. It lists only robot_1 and robot_2 as involved and leaves the queued robot_3 and robot_4 on 'continue'.

Check: the grounder's queued-robot hold added robot_3 and robot_4 to the crossing order and holds them until the gate admits each one (plan repaired, 2 edits: 'continue' became 'cross'). The yielder correction was armed and did not fire: robot_2 already had room to back out.
Dispatch: robot_2 is sent 'yield'; robot_1, robot_3 and robot_4 wait (temporary_wait) for their turn at the gate.
robot_2 has backed out and pulled aside. The gate admits robot_1 first and escorts it through; robot_3 and robot_4 stay held.
robot_1 is through. The gate admits robot_3; robot_4 stays held.
robot_3 is through. The gate admits robot_4.
robot_4 is through. The gate releases robot_2, which drives back west through the empty gate; on the way it passes 0.0185 m from the south barrier (no contact, by an offline recompute).
Trigger: robot_2 has been stuck for 12 s on its way back; the model is asked again.
The model answered 'no congestion'; nothing was dispatched. robot_2 continues home under its normal navigation (Nav2).

at.match: robot robot_2 arrived at base goal

outcome.text: Outcome: Resolved — grounder held the queued robots; model chose strategy and yielder. 4 of 4 robots arrived (ground truth, sim s: robot_1 75.3, robot_3 116.4, robot_4 158.1, robot_2 180.1).

legend: Legend: yield = back out and pull aside · cross = drive through · continue = keep driving · temporary_wait = hold still until admitted · provenance: repaired = edited by the grounder's verifier · dispatch_order_source=chi = the grounder's own ordering · gate_admit / gate_cleared / gate_release = M4 lets one robot through the gate, sees it clear, then releases the yielder · 'safety stop … min_distance_violation' (dim) = robots closer than 0.45 m are held still by the safety monitor · robot_35 (start-up lines only) = a perception ghost id, not a robot.
disclosure: Illustrative demo, not controlled experimental evidence; not evidence that the VLM resolves convoy congestion.
outro_title: Outcome: Resolved — grounder held the queued robots; model chose strategy and yielder
outro_lines: 4 of 4 robots arrived, in the order robot_1, robot_3, robot_4, then robot_2. Rerun, demonstration take 1 of 1, after five unresolved convoy takes.
The model's: the yield strategy, robot_2 as yielder and robot_1 as passer. It named only robot_1 and robot_2.

The system's: when to ask; the grounder's queued-robot hold (robot_3 and robot_4 added to the crossing order and held; plan repaired, 2 edits), the park point and distances; M4's gate admissions and escorts; robot_2's drive home (Nav2).

Caveats: n = 1. The yielder correction was armed but did not fire, so it is untested live. Closest non-exempted pair 0.497 m against a 0.45 m safety distance. Not evidence that the VLM resolves convoy congestion.
